template.colour: RGB hex from tokens.json (official tokens); print values (CMYK) are in tokens.json

reference_note: Faithful vector reproduction of the source page (source colours as a viewer shows them, original copy including typos). Hidden leftovers are listed under omitted.

copy_corrections.corrected: 5611 BM Eindhoven (space in the postcode, as on the envelope)

notes: A4 portrait, no bleed and no BleedBox in the source (page = trim, everything else is white paper); the template adds 3 mm bleed (white). Blank page below the header block. Lockup: py-comp-lockup-logo-tagline-color at scale 0.515 (beeldmerk 12.4 x 14.9 mm at x 20.2, y 12.2; the tagline is live text inside the comp, aqua), the registered mark py-atom-mark-registered 0.75 mm right of the wordmark, level with its top. Address block: recomposed from py-comp-address-block-brief (right edge 187.26 mm, 3.17 mm Ubuntu, Bold company line) as five live text lines with data-variable (company, street, postcode-city, email, website). The source address text is CMYK 100/85.5/22.3/4 (viewer #1E4382, a drifted blue, listed in observed); the logo is CMYK 100/83/0/17 (viewer #0B3D8A, equal to the token); the template uses #1A3580 for both. Open point (layout): the address block is not aligned with the logo, its top line sits 3.5 mm above the wordmark baseline and its left start is ragged by design (right aligned). No margins, folding marks or a window position are drawn in the source; the owner may want to add them (DIN 5008 starts the address window at 45 mm).
